chunk: EMBEDDED-PLAN.md 4.D, tool/codemode half (D2): @earendil-works/pi-durable/codemode, /tool-search, harness/tool.ts tokens, and the embedded @earendil-works/pi-codemode
summary: Each file runs byte-for-byte unchanged in pi-jsrt (Boa) against the embedded modules, in both PI_DURABLE_DOCUMENT_RETENTION_MS modes (unset, 0), no name filter, original timeouts; every case passes. Execution reaches Rust (nativeCalls). Durable code mode runs in the in-process stock service (crates/pi-durable/examples/task_stock_bridge.rs via src/dispatch/transport.rs); only the caller's sandbox, globals and model collections are called back. The sandbox is the embedded @earendil-works/pi-codemode over the native pi-codemode Boa VM (QuickJS wasm cannot run in Boa): Every runtime export of @earendil-works/pi-codemode is embedded: CodemodeSandbox (start and execute with live JS tools, globals, store, abort, close, acquireWorker/onWorkerStarted), InlineCodemodeSandbox (interrupt budget), RemoteCodemodeSandbox and serveCodemodeRemote (the caller's JS remote and exchange), declarations and source. loadQuickJSWasm resolves to an inert stand-in: there is no QuickJS module to load (a wasm promise that rejects still fails executions as upstream). Cases classed n/a depend on QuickJS, Node workers or V8 and are justified per case; every other case passes.

cases.reason: Engine identity, by design. The fingerprint names the VM so a replay never continues on a different one: durable code mode records it in CodemodeRunDoc.start.fingerprint on the first run and refuses to resume when it differs (packages/durable/src/codemode/codemode.ts checkFingerprint, test 'refuses to resume when the sandbox's fingerprint or the code mode version changed'). A run started under QuickJS cannot resume on Boa, nor on another QuickJS version, upstream either. Reporting 'quickjs-wasi …, quickjs …' from Boa would let such a run resume on a VM whose observable behaviour differs (error messages, interrupt-budget units, no heap limit), breaking replay without notice. Completed work interchanges: journal entries, results, store values and outputs are plain JSON in the documents. Math.random now produces QuickJS's exact values for every seed (xorshift64*, state seed + 1, one draw at context creation; pi-codemode determinism version 5), so a fresh replay of the same script and results makes the same calls on either engine. The rest of the case (idle/issued reporting) passes. The native fingerprint is 'boa 0.22, prelude …, deterministic 5, stack …, heap …, budget …'.
